questions.q: Where do you start if the drone won't arm in Betaflight?
options: The status command in the CLI
questions.explain: status shows the Arming disable flags — the firmware names the cause itself.

options: The OSD menu is open during arming
questions.explain: Check the port, protocol and inversion, the bind and 5 V at the receiver.

questions.q: One motor doesn't spin. What's the first cheap step?
options: Reflash the ESC and calibrate the throttle
questions.explain: Swap with a working motor: if the problem moved with the wire — it's the signal/FC pad; if it stayed — it's the ESC/motor.

questions.q: The smoke stopper bulb glows brightly, the vehicle doesn't power up:
options: The battery is discharged below the BEC threshold
questions.explain: Disconnect the loads one at a time: where the bulb goes out — that's the short.

questions.q: It shakes above 70% throttle. What's the first action?
options: Reduce P on all axes by 20 %
Record a Blackbox log and the spectrum
questions.explain: Without a log you're guessing; the spectrum distinguishes mechanics, filtering and resonance.

questions.q: The sign of an ESC desync in the log:
options: An LQ drop at the moment of a throttle punch
An eRPM dip on one motor
questions.explain: A sudden eRPM dip on one motor with a jerk: ESC settings, DShot, phases.

questions.q: The “one change — one test” rule is needed in order to:
options: Avoid touching the CLI unnecessarily between flights
questions.explain: Two changes at once — the cause isn't established.

questions.q: The ANGLE flag when arming in Betaflight means:
options: The vehicle is tilted more than small_angle
questions.explain: ANGLE means a tilt greater than small_angle: set it level or calibrate the accelerometer.
